name: theta-chain-census
notes: H-census of ADR-0265, the gate before any ThetaData hypothesis runs: for each root of the landed option_eod stream (ADR-0263), the first and last date with a bid above zero, the share of null / zero / crossed / locked quotes, the share of vendor iv_error placeholders (100), rows per date by year, non-standard strikes by month (a corporate-action marker), the median usable quotes per date and the development-years liquidity terciles. READ-ONLY: the store at /home/russell/data/thetadata/options-tested (onboarding root, source theta, stream option_eod) is only read; a pull may be landing new acquisitions underneath, and the reader pins the members it fingerprinted, so a run describes exactly the acquisitions present when it started (the fingerprint names them). first_bid_date and every share are WHOLE-SAMPLE statistics: a universe gate for a test must be recomputed from dates up to that test's start only. SEALED PERIOD: end_before 2026-01-01 on the census node, which REFUSES any row dated on or after it (the registered stores end 2025-12-31, so none is expected; the node parses a row before it can refuse it). TERCILES use dates before 2021-01-01 only (ADR-0265 item 2: fixed on development years). STRIKE GRID: half-dollar steps below 200 and whole dollars above are a first-pass listed-grid approximation, not an exchange table; an adjusted strike (a third of a dollar, say) falls off it, which is the marker. The count by month is read against the split inventory by hand. NOT DONE HERE: the underlying_price versus Alpaca close check (the census node takes an optional second input 'closes' of daily close rows; none is wired, so the node lists the check under summary.skipped and the run report says so) and the overlap with the Alpaca chains. Nothing is fitted, tested or ranked; the output freezes the universe. Run from children/index_options: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-theta-chain-census.json --asof 2025-12-31.

outputs.notes: A new directory beside the other research runs; nothing is written under /home/russell/data/thetadata. Excluded from the identity hash.

chain.notes: The ThetaData daily chain through the onboarding read seam, newest member first, deduplicated by UNIT (symbol, date) only: the latest-acquired copy of a (root, date) wins and older copies are skipped and counted (a batch re-pulled after a crash, or a revised day), so memory is the number of units, not the number of rows (the per-row key table of ObservationStreamRows would hold about 200 bytes for each of about 2 billion rows). An older copy with another row count is a split unit: it is counted as unit_row_mismatch and the census refuses unless allow_unit_mismatch is set. Projected to the seven fields the census reads. Lazy. Read-only. The reader's counters (members, rows, units, skipped rows) land in the census summary under reader.

census.notes: One pass over the stream. A quote is null (a missing side), zero (a side at or below zero), crossed (ask below bid), locked (ask equal to bid) or quoted; usable = locked or quoted. first_bid_date is the first date any contract has a bid above zero: the universe gate of ADR-0265 item 2. iv_error_flag 100 is the vendor's placeholder code (4.3% of rows per ADR-0265). An empty stream, or a row on or after end_before, refuses.

params.source: one row per root: first and last bid date, quote-state shares over all rows and from the first bid date, iv_error placeholder share, median usable quotes per date (all dates and development years), liquidity tercile, non-standard strike rows

coverage.notes: The per-root coverage and quality table; the frozen universe is read from it.

params.source: one row per root and calendar year: rows, dates and rows per date

by_year.notes: Rows per date by year, the thinning of a chain over time.

params.source: one row per root and month: rows, rows at a strike off the listed grid and the distinct such strikes

by_month.notes: Non-standard strikes by month: the corporate-action marker.

report.notes: evidence.md renders the run totals, the quote-state counts and the list of checks that did not run (summary.skipped); evidence.json holds every value.
